provider: NCBI PubChem / National Library of Medicine
method: Names resolved individually through PUG REST; formula, IUPAC name, SMILES and stereo counts inspected. Single returned CID required, except alpha-bisabolol whose unspecified-stereochemistry CID 10586 is explicitly selected among four results. Original PNG bytes downloaded by the selected CID; no chemical drawing created or modified by AI.
displayRequirements: Keep isomerNote beside the detailed depiction, especially when PubChem specifies a stereoisomer.
Do not infer a sample’s configuration, concentration, effects or detection from the picture.
Do not substitute a family illustration for an absent molecular structure.
